parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-supplied unique key (e.g. a UUID) identifying this creation attempt. **Clients must always send a non-empty key**: a Postgres-backed deployment rejects a missing key with `400 idempotency-key-required` (the in-memory development configuration ignores the header, which is why the schema marks it optional). Retries of the same logical request must reuse it; a genuinely different request must use a new one.
